craft_notes: Sthāyin: boundary — barred even for knowers. Rows: bar then alternatives. Rejected: softening — killed: hell is the doctrine. Read aloud: stern close.

lines: But to feast on cat and mouse and dog breeds doubt — hellward.
Not even the wise, to bless the world, should stoop; or quit the world and sit. So ends the hearth-rite.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mārjāramūṣakaśvādibhakṣaṇe tu śaṅkā janitā nirayāya iti jñānī api lokānugrahecchayā na tādṛk kuryāt lokaṃ vā parityajya āsīta iti sthaṇḍilayāgaḥ
